correctness.rationale: For dyadic three-sets pairwise differences have valuations a,a,b (a<b); character annihilation gives exact rank thresholds a+c>=k (rank1), else b+c>=k or a+d>=k (rank2). Unique-close-pair count M_(a,b)=2^(3k-a-b-3), and finite geometric sums give displayed polynomial counts. Independent integer evaluation of rank-partition sums exactly reproduced displayed rank-one and rank-two polynomials for k=3..7; not an all-k substitute.
